card.name: Section numbers in label cross-references
card.fires_on: The digit or space inside a section cross-reference such as (5.2) or Table 1 in drug-label text, mostly for SPRAVATO. Also weakly on a few odd spots like 'known as' or partway through 'paroxetine'.

modes.label: Section reference numbers
modes.description: The first digit of a bracketed section number after Warnings and Precautions or Dosage and Administration.

modes.label: Space before a number
modes.description: The space before a section or table number in a label.

modes.label: Other scattered spots
modes.description: Occasional hits on 'as' in 'known as' or inside a drug name.
